selections.rationale: Figure 4 is the clearest input-route schematic: it explicitly shows NCBI NT nucleotide sequences paired with text annotations as pre-training inputs into the transformer decoder, matching the model’s sequence/text prompt pathway better than the evaluation or embedding figures.

Figure 5A in Figure 8 directly shows the mutation-effect workflow built from wild-type and mutated nucleotide sequences and their log-likelihood comparison, which is the only candidate that visibly exposes the model-visible input pair for OmniNA-1.7B.
